title: Brownfield VCF workload-domain migration architecture
prompt:
Build the migration architecture for the newly added `chi-wld01` workload domain in the existing VCF fleet described by `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`. The workload domain starts on VCF 4.5.1 and must reach the fixture's VCF 5.2.2 target through supported releases, while every management-domain component remains at its current version and is never included in an upgrade step.

Before implementing, use genuine network access to research Broadcom's published VMware Cloud Foundation compatibility/interoperability material and official upgrade or bundle material. Consult live, reachable sources rather than relying only on the shipped fixtures. In `research-sources.md`, record a single access date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, then use at least two Markdown bullets in the form `[source title](exact HTTPS URL) — compatibility or ordering decision`. Source selection is yours; do not treat the pinned snapshot as a substitute for this research. Live material may change, so use `fixtures/compatibility-snapshot.json` as the deterministic authority when producing the checked-in architecture.

Implement `VcfBrownfieldArchitecture/VcfBrownfieldArchitecture.psd1` and `.psm1`. The module must use the environment-provided `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` PowerCLI module for live SDDC Manager inventory and must not install, vendor, mock, or replace VMware modules or harness tools. Export `Get-VcfWorkloadDomainInventory` for SDK-backed inventory collection and `New-VcfWorkloadDomainMigrationPlan` for deterministic planning from the shipped inventory and compatibility snapshot. The planning command must accept `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilityPath`, and `-OutputPath` and write the artifact without contacting a VMware endpoint.

Produce `architecture/migration-plan.json`. It is an ordered migration plan, not a prose explanation. It must validate against the fixed `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`, whose top-level integration envelope is also an `SddcSpec` from `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` at `vmware/vcf-api-specs` tag `9.1.0.0`. Use the literal non-secret marker `REDACTED!` for the schema-required existing-vCenter password field. Name every inventory component with its current version, final target, disposition, and gates; include each supported release hop and the ordered NSX Manager, vCenter, then ESXi actions for the workload domain. The checked-in artifact must be reproducible by `New-VcfWorkloadDomainMigrationPlan` from the two fixture files. Do not modify the fixtures, schemas, specification, license, or verifier. Run `python3 verify/verify.py` when finished.
